top_story.headline: Rep. Dan Crenshaw still has no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 80 days past his final extension
top_story.dek: The Deadline Watch check found him as the only sitting member of Congress with no CY2025 annual report filed after every extension had run out.
paragraphs: Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed for an extension on 6/4/2026. The final extension date was 8/13/2026, and as of today his calendar-year 2025 annual financial disclosure is still not on file, 80 days past that date.

The check compared every sitting member against the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD. Members sworn in after Nov. 1 of the report year are excluded. The Senate half of the check failed to run today, so the result is only partial. The tool also warns that a filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can look like a missing one, so the finding rests on the Clerk index lookup alone.
Nothing else in today's input rivals it. No filings turned up in the Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet block, no FARA items were new, and none of the 7 LDA reports carried a signal.

sections.headline: No new notable ethics filings or divestitures reported
paragraphs: The Office of Government Ethics portal recorded zero flagged filings such as certificates of divestiture or termination agreements during this monitoring window, and no routine financial disclosures were indexed for review.

sections.headline: No new House or Senate disclosures in the input
paragraphs: The input held no House or Senate financial disclosures filed since 10/29/2026 that earlier editions had not already reported. The Senate eFD fetch returned an error, so this cannot confirm that no Senate filings were posted.

sections.headline: Seven third-quarter reports, no registrations or terminations
paragraphs: Seven filings were posted to the LDA database since 10/31/2026, all 3rd Quarter activity reports. None was a new registration or termination, and none carried a signal such as covered former officials, foreign entities, conviction disclosures or unusual money. All seven are left out as routine.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.

footer.coverage_window: FARA and LDA filings posted 2026-10-31 onward; House and Senate disclosures filed 2026-10-29 onward, minus those reported in earlier editions; TOP OFFICIALS scan of FARA filings stamped 2026-10-18 onward.

footer.known_gaps: Senate eFD fetch failed (Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)), so Senate filings for this window could not be checked. The Deadline Watch Senate annual-report check and Senate extensions check also failed with the same error, leaving that check partial. The OGE section reported no flagged filings and no routine financial disclosures indexed for review in this window.
